agent.description: The child agent to stop: its name from `list_agents` or its Session id.

provider.description: A registered provider id or display name; omit for every provider.

description.description: A short 3-5 word description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained task for the subagent. It does not share this conversation's context, so include everything it needs.

name.description: Optional subagent name, unique among the parent's children; lets list_agents and send_message address it by name.

agent_preset.description: Optional child agent preset; defaults to "general". "poteto-agent" for pstack implementation, "comment-sicko" for comment review, "readonly" for a sandbox-enforced read-only researcher.

provider.description: Optional model provider; pass together with `model` to override the child route, or omit both to inherit the parent route.

model.description: Optional model id; pass together with `provider` to override the child route, or omit both to inherit the parent route.

reasoning_effort.description: Optional advertised reasoning-effort token; requires `provider` and `model`. Omit it to use the target model's default when changing routes, or inherit the parent's current effort when keeping the same route.

maxDepth.description: Optional delegation-depth cap. Omit or null to use the configured row limit, or the Host default when the row has no limit.
